Synopsis:
    Maltese businessman Yorgen Fenech was acquitted by an 8-1 jury vote of commissioning the 2017 murder of investigative journalist Daphne Caruana Galizia. The verdict has sparked public outrage from the victim's family, press freedom groups, and the opposition, who are calling for a parliamentary recall. The government urged restraint. Prosecutors face near-insurmountable barriers to appeal. The case remains a deep political wound in Malta with no forward resolution in sight.
